Definition: to collar, i.e. adorn with a necklace; figuratively, to fit out with supplies
BiblicalUsage: 1) to serve as a necklace, adorn with a neck ornament; 1a) (Qal) to serve as a necklace; 1b) (Hiphil) to make a necklace
